desc: Ideate approaches and select product-indexed sum-bitset DP with separate zero feasibility.
Abandon verbose full product-indexed DP attempt; switch to concise bitset implementation.
Implement positive-product bitset DP (dp0/dp1 arrays, previous-snapshot transitions, singleton after loop, skip x>limit, x=1 safe).
Implement zero-product feasibility bitset DP (no_zero/has_zero parity bitsets, zero toggles parity, positives append).
Combine results with early abs(k)>sum check, scan products descending, fallback to zero, and validate examples/edge cases.
